title: US album release: New by Paul McCartney
content:
Paul McCartney’s 16th solo studio album, New, was released by Hear Music on 15 October 2013 in the United States.

It was issued in four formats: standard, deluxe, vinyl and digital download. The deluxe edition contained two bonus tracks: ‘Turned Out’ and ‘Get Me Out Of Here’.

The album was McCartney’s first since 2007’s Memory Almost Full to consist entirely of new compositions. It was released the previous day in the United Kingdom.
